Most needed

  • Rice and pasta
  • Canned legumes
  • Peanut butter
  • Cereal
  • Shelf-stable milk
  • Canned meat or fish
  • Diapers (sizes 4–6)
  • Hygiene products

Please avoid homemade, opened or expired products, and glass.

Run a grocery store?

Become a drop-off point: one table, two volunteers, one day. We take care of everything else.

La Paix du Cœur Kimia Na Motema

A Christian charity in Montréal since 2014: street outreach, food drives and mutual aid for orphans, widows, people in need and the homeless.
